title: Returning a part to inventory (restocking) is controlled by Vendor and order management
current_excerpt: With Vendor and order management Create & Edit, the Return to Inventory action works and stock goes up. With Vendor and order management View only, the return is not possible.
proposed_text: OPEN QUESTION for Bilal/Vlad + PO: which permission gates 'Return to Inventory' (restocking)? The spec is internally ambiguous: Open Question 3 (answered) says Catalog and Inventory: Edit includes 'return to inventory'; §1f Catalog Edit says 'make inventory adjustments including returning items to inventory'; but §1g Vendor Edit also says 'Includes returning parts to vendors or inventory.' This case gates restocking solely on Vendor and order management. Confirm whether Return-to-Inventory is gated by Catalog & Inventory: Edit (per OQ3/§1f) or Vendor & Order Management: Edit (per §1g) — likely both surfaces exist for different flows. Case is Blocked-UI (never verified).
reason: Spec is self-contradictory on the restocking gate (OQ3/§1f = Catalog Edit; §1g = Vendor Edit). Needs PO clarification, not a silent rewrite.
citation: Spec Open Question 3; §1f Catalog Edit; §1g Vendor Edit.
